title: Widget settings closed without applying edited sensor label reopens with editing mode already activated but that does not react to keyboard input
line: Reopening a System Monitor widget's settings no longer shows a sensor label still stuck in edit mode from last time.
explanation: The Sensors Details page of System Monitor widgets is created once and reused every time the settings window opens. A sensor label editor is a per-row state that was only reset when the edit was confirmed, so closing the settings with OK or Cancel while editing left that row in edit mode, with the half-typed text, the next time. The change keeps the editing state in a delegate property and closes every label editor whenever the sensors page is shown again.

commits.message:
faces: Close open label editors when the sensors page is shown again

The sensors page is created once and reused every time the settings are
opened, so a label editor left open stayed open, with stale text, the next
time. Close all label editors when the page is shown again.

BUG: 442694

media.caption: Master: the pencil on Core 1 opens its label editor; then OK is pressed.
Master: reopening Configure > Sensors Details, Core 1 is still in edit mode.
With the fix: the label editor on Core 1 is open (text typed), then OK is pressed.
With the fix: reopening Configure > Sensors Details shows every row normally.

reviews.text: Cleanly fixes the stale edit-mode state on System Monitor widget settings reopen by driving the delegate's editing state from a declarative delegate.editing property in Choices.qml and calling stopEditing() on all three Choices instances in ConfigSensors.qml's onParentChanged. Matches ConfigSensors.qml's existing page-reuse pattern, passes sensorfacecontrollertest, and is well-verified for both OK and Cancel flows. (Minor non-blocking polish: also calling stopEditing() when !parent would tear down editLoader immediately on close and avoid a shrink transition on reopen.)

Right cause: the Sensors Details page is cached and reused, and the delegate's 'editing' state was only cleared on accept, so an editor left open came back on reopen. Moving the state to a delegate 'editing' property (State.when) and closing every editor in onParentChanged, the same place that already reloads config when the page is shown again, is clean. Deactivating the Loader destroys the TextField, so no stale text survives. It matches the reporter's expected result, the after screenshot shows every row normal after OK and reopen, and the commit message, line and explanation match the diff.
